meta.title: Lighthouse 13
meta.subject: perseverance
meta.author: mission_architect
meta.design_note: Designed for 1-2 player sessions. Two lighthouse keepers on a remote rock in the North Atlantic. A Category 4 storm hits. Keep the light burning, the foghorn sounding, and the radio alive — or ships wreck on the rocks.

direct.label: Lamp bearing — NORTH!
direct.narrator_line: Lamp Keeper! Swing the beam north — ship on the rocks!

direct.label: Lamp bearing — SOUTH!
direct.narrator_line: South! The beam — south! Trawler in the channel!

direct.label: Lamp bearing — EAST!
direct.narrator_line: East bearing! Sweep the reef — something's out there!

direct.label: Lamp bearing — WEST!
direct.narrator_line: West! Point the lamp west — the headland!

direct.label: Full brightness!
direct.narrator_line: Full brightness! Max the beam — they can't see us!

direct.label: Half brightness — save fuel!
direct.narrator_line: Half power — conserve the oil! We need it to last!

direct.label: Low beam — emergency!
direct.narrator_line: Low beam only — the generator's struggling!

direct.label: Open left shutter!
direct.narrator_line: Left shutter — open it! Clear the lens!

direct.label: Close left shutter!
direct.narrator_line: Shut the left shutter — debris incoming!

direct.label: Open right shutter!
direct.narrator_line: Right shutter — get that side open!

direct.label: Close right shutter!
direct.narrator_line: Right side shut! The spray will kill the lens!

direct.label: Backup lamp — ON!
direct.narrator_line: Backup lamp on! The main might fail — be ready!

direct.label: Backup lamp — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the backup — it's drawing too much power!

direct.label: IGNITE the lamp!
direct.narrator_line: Ignite! Light that lamp — NOW!

direct.label: Flash signal — three!
direct.narrator_line: Flash it! Three pulses — warn that trawler!

direct.label: Generator to FULL!
direct.narrator_line: Mechanic! Generator to full — we need every watt!

direct.label: Generator to half!
direct.narrator_line: Half power on the genny — it's overheating!

direct.label: Generator to idle!
direct.narrator_line: Idle the generator! Cool it down before it seizes!

direct.label: Kill the generator!
direct.narrator_line: Kill it! Shut the generator down — fire risk!

direct.label: Wire: main power relay!
direct.narrator_line: Mechanic! Patch the main power relay — jacks in!

direct.label: Wire: backup generator!
direct.narrator_line: Backup generator wiring — swap those jacks NOW!

direct.label: Wire: foghorn circuit!
direct.narrator_line: Foghorn circuit! Reroute those jacks — it's dead!

direct.label: Open fuel valve!
direct.narrator_line: Fuel valve — open! Feed the generator!

direct.label: Close fuel valve!
direct.narrator_line: Close the fuel! We're flooding the engine!

direct.label: Oil pressure — engage!
direct.narrator_line: Oil pressure! Engage the feed — bearings are dry!

direct.label: Oil pressure — release!
direct.narrator_line: Release the oil pressure — it's too high!

direct.label: Wrench — tighten coupling!
direct.narrator_line: Tighten that coupling! Wrench it shut — NOW!

direct.label: Loosen the coupling!
direct.narrator_line: Loosen the coupling — it's cross-threaded!

direct.label: Start the bilge pump!
direct.narrator_line: Pump! Start the bilge — water's coming in!

direct.label: Emergency freq 121!
direct.narrator_line: Signalman! Frequency one-two-one — emergency band!

direct.label: Coast Guard: freq 156!
direct.narrator_line: One-five-six — that's the Coast Guard! Hail them!

direct.label: Weather service: freq 200!
direct.narrator_line: Two hundred — weather service! Get the latest forecast!

direct.label: Ship channel: freq 80!
direct.narrator_line: Eighty — the shipping channel! Warn them off!

direct.label: Distress code: 2-1-8-2!
direct.narrator_line: Signalman! Code two-one-eight-two — international distress!

direct.label: Relay code: 5-0-5!
direct.narrator_line: Five-zero-five — the relay station! Patch us through!

direct.label: Station code: 7-3-0!
direct.narrator_line: Seven-three-zero — our station ID! Send it!

direct.label: FOGHORN — ON!
direct.narrator_line: Foghorn! Sound it — ships in the channel!

direct.label: Foghorn — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Kill the foghorn — it's drawing too much power!

direct.label: Send distress signal!
direct.narrator_line: Distress signal! Broadcast it — we need help!

direct.label: Cancel distress!
direct.narrator_line: Cancel distress — false alarm! We've got it handled!

direct.label: Broadcast storm warning!
direct.narrator_line: Storm warning! Broadcast it to all ships!

direct.label: Morse key — send SOS!
direct.narrator_line: Morse key! S-O-S — dit dit dit dah dah dah dit dit dit!

direct.label: Fog horn — FULL BLAST!
direct.narrator_line: Watch! Fog horn to maximum — warn the ships!

direct.label: Fog horn — HALF POWER!
direct.narrator_line: Half power on the fog horn — conserve the air reserves!

direct.label: Door seal: MAIN entry!
direct.narrator_line: Main door seal — position one! Lock it down!

direct.label: Door seal: STORM port!
direct.narrator_line: Storm port — position two! Reinforce that seal!

direct.label: Door seal: TOWER hatch!
direct.narrator_line: Tower hatch — position three! Seal the top!

direct.label: North watch — eyes out!
direct.narrator_line: North watch! Eyes open — check the sea state!

direct.label: North watch — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: North watch stand down — nothing on that bearing!

direct.label: South watch — eyes out!
direct.narrator_line: South! Watch the south — breakers on the rocks!

direct.label: South watch — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: South clear. Stand down on that bearing.

direct.label: FIRE the flare!
direct.narrator_line: Flare! Fire it! Let them know we're here!

direct.label: First aid — RED bandage!
direct.narrator_line: Keeper's Mate! Red bandage — stop the bleeding!

direct.label: Green salve — burns!
direct.narrator_line: Green salve — treat the steam burns! Quick!

direct.label: Blue tonic — cold!
direct.narrator_line: Blue tonic! Warm them up — hypothermia setting in!

direct.label: Warmth dial to 180!
direct.narrator_line: Warmth dial to one-eighty — crank the stove up!

direct.label: Warmth to 100 — steady!
direct.narrator_line: One hundred — steady heat. Conserve the fuel.

direct.label: Warmth to 50 — conserve!
direct.narrator_line: Fifty — minimum warmth. We need the fuel for the lamp!

direct.label: Apply bandage!
direct.narrator_line: Bandage on! Wrap it tight — stop the bleeding!

direct.label: Remove bandage!
direct.narrator_line: Old bandage off — rewrap it clean!

direct.label: Throw the blanket!
direct.narrator_line: Blanket! Get it around them — they're shaking!

direct.label: Hot drink — NOW!
direct.narrator_line: Hot drink! Boil the kettle — someone needs warming!

direct.label: Barometer: set 1-0-1-3!
direct.narrator_line: Weather Eye! Barometer to one-zero-one-three — calibrate!

direct.label: Barometer: set 9-8-0!
direct.narrator_line: Nine-eight-zero! The pressure's dropping — log it!

direct.label: Barometer: set 9-6-0!
direct.narrator_line: Nine-six-zero — catastrophic drop! This storm is a monster!

direct.label: Wind gauge: GALE!
direct.narrator_line: Wind gauge! Gale force — position three! Log it!

direct.label: Wind gauge: HURRICANE!
direct.narrator_line: Hurricane force! Position five — off the scale!

direct.label: Wind gauge: LULL!
direct.narrator_line: Lull — position one! Eye of the storm? Log it!

direct.label: Storm tracking — ON!
direct.narrator_line: Storm tracking on! Plot the path — where's it heading?

direct.label: Storm tracking — OFF!
direct.narrator_line: Tracking off — save the battery for the radio!

direct.label: Check the tide chart!
direct.narrator_line: Tide chart! When's high tide — are we getting swamped?

direct.label: Tide chart — stow it!
direct.narrator_line: Stow the chart — hold on to something!

direct.label: Log entry — mark it!
direct.narrator_line: Log it! Mark the time and conditions — for the record!

direct.label: Wave height — scan NORTH!
direct.narrator_line: Coast Watch! Scan north — big swells building!

direct.label: Wave height — scan SOUTH!
direct.narrator_line: Scan south — massive swells from the open ocean!

direct.label: Wave — scan EAST reef!
direct.narrator_line: East! Scan the reef — the breakers are enormous!

direct.label: Wave — scan WEST shore!
direct.narrator_line: West shore! Sweep for debris — something broke loose!

direct.label: Sea state: match GREEN!
direct.narrator_line: Coast Watch! Green light — match the starboard marker!

direct.label: Sea state: match RED!
direct.narrator_line: Red! Match the port marker — that ship needs bearing!

direct.label: Sea state: match WHITE!
direct.narrator_line: White light! Match it — signal the all-clear to the tanker!

direct.label: Open the porthole!
direct.narrator_line: Porthole! Open it — I need eyes on the water!

direct.label: Close the porthole!
direct.narrator_line: Shut the porthole! Wave incoming — SEAL IT!

direct.label: East shore — watch!
direct.narrator_line: East shore! Eyes on it — the reef is breaking!

direct.label: East shore — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: East clear — shift your eyes elsewhere!

direct.label: West shore — watch!
direct.narrator_line: West shore! Report — any ships in distress?

direct.label: West shore — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: West clear — nothing on that bearing!

direct.label: Spyglass — look out!
direct.narrator_line: Spyglass! Scan the horizon — what's out there?

direct.label: Wire: normal operations!
direct.narrator_line: Head Keeper! Normal ops wiring — jacks in standard!

direct.label: Wire: storm protocol!
direct.narrator_line: Storm wiring! Reroute those jacks — priority power!

direct.label: Wire: EMERGENCY routing!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency routing! Swap those jacks — everything to lamp!

direct.label: Scan the STATION LOG!
direct.narrator_line: Head Keeper! The station log — scan it! What's protocol?

direct.label: Scan EMERGENCY ORDERS!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency orders! Scan them — what does HQ say?

direct.label: LOCK DOWN the station!
direct.narrator_line: Lockdown! Seal every door — ride this out!

direct.label: End lockdown!
direct.narrator_line: Lockdown lifted! Open the hatches — we need air!

direct.label: Confirm the order!
direct.narrator_line: Confirm! Execute the order — NOW!

direct.label: ALL HANDS!
direct.narrator_line: All hands! Everyone to stations — no rest!

direct.label: MAYDAY! MAYDAY!
direct.narrator_line: MAYDAY! Send the mayday! We're going under!

cooperative.label: Tell Lamp: bearing NORTH!
cooperative.narrator_line: Head Keeper! Tell the Lamp Keeper — north bearing!

cooperative.label: Tell Lamp: full brightness!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mechanic! Tell the Lamp Keeper — full brightness!

cooperative.label: Tell Mechanic: gen to full!
cooperative.narrator_line: Weather Eye! Tell the Mechanic — generator to full!

cooperative.label: Tell Mechanic: gen to half!
cooperative.narrator_line: Head Keeper! Tell the Mechanic — half power!

cooperative.label: Tell Signals: freq 121!
cooperative.narrator_line: Lamp Keeper! Tell the Signalman — one-two-one!

cooperative.label: Tell Signals: freq 156!
cooperative.narrator_line: Coast Watch! Tell the Signalman — one-five-six!

cooperative.label: Tell Watch: fire flare!
cooperative.narrator_line: Signalman! Tell the Watch — fire a flare!

cooperative.label: Tell Watch: storm port!
cooperative.narrator_line: Keeper's Mate! Tell the Watch — seal the storm port!

cooperative.label: Tell Mate: apply bandage!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mechanic! Tell the Keeper's Mate — bandage that wound!

cooperative.label: Tell Mate: hot drink!
cooperative.narrator_line: Watch! Tell the Keeper's Mate — hot drink, NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Weather: baro 1-0-1-3!
cooperative.narrator_line: Lamp Keeper! Tell Weather Eye — baro one-zero-one-three!

cooperative.label: Tell Weather: wind hurricane!
cooperative.narrator_line: Watch! Tell Weather Eye — wind gauge to hurricane!

cooperative.label: Tell Coast: scan north!
cooperative.narrator_line: Weather Eye! Tell Coast Watch — scan north! Big swells!

cooperative.label: Tell Coast: open porthole!
cooperative.narrator_line: Signalman! Tell Coast Watch — eyes on the water!

cooperative.label: Tell Head: storm wiring!
cooperative.narrator_line: Coast Watch! Tell the Head Keeper — storm wiring!

cooperative.label: Tell Head: lockdown!
cooperative.narrator_line: Keeper's Mate! Tell the Head — lockdown NOW!

open.label: Someone — scan EAST!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a scope — scan east! Something on the reef!

open.label: Anyone — full power!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a slider — full output! We need everything!

open.label: Quick — dial to 121!
open.narrator_line: Any dial operator — one-two-one! Emergency frequency!

open.label: Someone — match RED!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a color dial — red! Mark the danger zone!

open.label: Anyone — position TWO!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a selector — position two! Storm protocol!

open.label: Someone — code 1-2-1!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with a keypad — code one-two-one! Emergency override!

crises.label: ROGUE WAVE!
crises.narrator_line: ROGUE WAVE! BRACE! Everyone — GRAB SOMETHING AND HOLD!

crises.label: WINDOW BREACH!
crises.narrator_line: WINDOW BREACH! Water pouring in — everyone on the pumps!

crises.label: GENERATOR FIRE!
crises.narrator_line: FIRE! Generator's burning! Mechanic — kill the fuel! Signalman — sound the alarm!

crises.label: LAMP OUT!
crises.narrator_line: THE LAMP IS OUT! Keeper — relight it! Mechanic — generator NOW! Ships will WRECK!

narrator_lines: Lighthouse Thirteen. Forty miles off the coast. Just you and the Atlantic.
The barometer's been dropping all day. Nine-eighty and falling.
The weather office says it's a Category Four. The supply boat isn't coming.
The light must stay lit. The foghorn must sound. Ships are depending on you.
Here it comes.

phases.narrator_intro: Final check. Set your stations to starting positions. Green light when ready.

narrator_lines_ambient: Wind's picking up. Shutters rattling.
The sea is turning grey. White caps everywhere.
Generator's humming. Keep it fed.
First big swells hitting the base. Steady.

narrator_lines: Good work. Systems holding. The storm's just getting started.
But the light's bright and the foghorn's singing. We're ready.
Already falling behind. The generator sputtered twice.
The storm's not even at full strength yet. Dig in.

narrator_lines_ambient: Full gale. The tower is swaying.
A tanker on the radio — they're running blind without us!
Spray hitting the lamp room. Keep the shutters managed!
The whole island is shaking. Hold your nerve.
The generator's coughing. Oil pressure is wrong.
Water in the lower level. The pumps can't keep up.
Two ships on the radio — both asking if we're still lit!
Everything is failing at once. Prioritise! PRIORITISE!

narrator_lines: The eye of the storm. Eerie calm. Five minutes of peace.
Use it. Repair what you can. The back wall is coming.
The lamp flickered. Twice. A ship nearly hit the rocks.
The back half of this storm is going to be worse. Brace.
You clawed it back. Generator's running. Lamp's lit.
But the worst is still coming. The back wall of the storm.
The lower level is flooded. Generator room is ankle-deep.
If the light goes out now, that tanker hits the reef. MOVE!

narrator_lines_ambient: The back wall hits. FULL FORCE.
This is the worst of it. Everything you've got!
The tanker's through the channel — they made it!
Dawn is coming. Hold on. HOLD ON!
The back wall. Worse than the front.
Water everywhere. The stairwell is a waterfall.
Keep that light LIT! Lives depend on it!
Almost through. Don't quit now!
You've got the light back. Now KEEP it!
Back wall hitting — the whole tower groans!
The foghorn saved a fishing boat. They radioed thanks.
Sunrise is close. Just a little longer.
The lighthouse is groaning. Cracks in the wall.
The light is barely visible through the spray.
Mayday calls on every frequency. The coast is chaos.
If this tower holds, it'll be a miracle.

WWW.title: Unbroken
narrator_lines: Dawn. The storm breaks. Golden light on grey water.
The lamp never went out. Not once. The foghorn sang all night.
Every ship in the channel made it through safely.
The keepers of Lighthouse Thirteen. Unbroken.

WWL.title: Battered Standing
narrator_lines: A rough final act, but the light survived the night.
One ship reported a close call on the reef. Everyone made it.
The tower is battered. You're exhausted. But the job is done.

WLW.title: Second Wind
narrator_lines: The middle was terrifying. The lamp flickered. Hearts stopped.
But you clawed it back and the light held.
The supply boat crew can't believe the tower is still standing.

WLL.title: Dark Minutes
narrator_lines: The lamp went dark for eleven minutes. A fishing boat hit the rocks.
Everyone survived, but the boat is lost.
You kept the tower. The lighthouse lives. But it was too close.

LWW.title: Hand Cranked
narrator_lines: Terrible start. Magnificent finish.
After the generator stalled, you hand-cranked the backup and never stopped.
The light burned all night. Against all odds.

LWL.title: Candle in the Wind
narrator_lines: A night of close calls. The lamp went in and out like a candle.
Ships altered course three times based on your radio warnings alone.
You survived. The lighthouse survived. Barely.

LLW.title: Miracle Dawn
narrator_lines: By all rights, this tower should have gone dark.
But in the final hour, everything held — just barely.
When they ask how you made it, you won't have an answer.

LLL.title: Dark Watch
narrator_lines: The lamp went out. The foghorn went silent. The radio died.
The supply boat found you huddled in the lamp room, soaked and shivering.
No ships were lost — the Coast Guard diverted traffic in time. But Lighthouse Thirteen failed its watch.
